newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statfjord oil output unaffected by Karstoe closure.
newsitem.headline: Statfjord oil output unaffected by Karstoe closure.

text.p: Oil output at the North Sea Statfjord complex was running normally and had not been affected by the unscheduled closure of the gas terminal at Karstoe on the west coast of Norway, operator Den Norske Stats Oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Monday.
"There was enough gas injection capacity to reduce (gas) exports to Karstoe and increase injection without affecting oil production," Statoil spokesman Odd Jan Lange told Reuters.
Lange said gas exports had been reduced to 9.7 million cubic metres on Sunday compared with a usual 13 to 14 million cubic metres per day.
Statoil expects the Karstoe terminal to be shut for three weeks due to compressor failure and scheduled maintenance.
On Sunday the main Statfjord development pumped 483,827 barrels of oil, while the Statfjord East and North satellites produced 146,243 barrels and the Snorre platform 200,337 barrels.
